shortdesc.ph: Sets whether the SDK audio playback device follows the system default audio playback device.
Sets whether the SDK audio playback device follows the system default audio playback device.

section.p: When the system default audio playback device changes, the SDK automatically switches the audio playback device according to your setting.

plentry.pd: Whether to follow the system default audio playback device. YES: Follow the system default audio playback device. NO: Do not follow the system default audio playback device.
